condition.zh: 慢性病 · 心衰竭惡化

tagline.zh: 心臟沒有變壞，是水變多了
tagline.en: The heart did not get worse; the water did

desc.zh: 病房日：先看體重，再看腳踝，再看片子。找出這次心衰竭惡化的原因。
desc.en: A ward day: the weight first, then the ankles, then the film. Find out why the heart failure tipped over this time.

desc.zh: 量體重、記尿量、教家屬把衛教說回來。她一躺平就喘，第一個看到的是你。
desc.en: Weights, urine charts, and getting the family to say the teaching back. When she gasps lying flat, you see it first.

about.zh: 查房一定先翻體重表，再掀被子看腳踝。他說：「體重是最誠實的病歷。」
about.en: On rounds he reads the weight chart first and lifts the blanket to see the ankles second. "The scale is the most honest note in the chart."

about.zh: 口袋裡有一支醬油小湯匙，用來跟病人說「這一匙就是一天的鹽」。
about.en: Keeps a soy-sauce teaspoon in her pocket to show patients "this spoon is a whole day of salt".

role.zh: 病人・76 歲牛肉麵攤老闆娘

about.zh: 顧湯顧了四十年，一天試湯幾十口。上週停了利尿劑去喝喜酒，膝蓋痛又吃了鄰居給的止痛藥。
about.en: Has tended the broth for forty years, tasting it dozens of times a day. Last week she skipped her water pill for a wedding banquet and took a neighbour's painkiller for her knee.

role.en: Family, son, now runs the stall

about.zh: 白天是工程師，晚上幫媽媽顧攤。覺得媽媽瘦了，想帶一碗湯給她補。
about.en: Engineer by day, noodle stall by night. Thinks his mother looks thin and wants to bring her a bowl of broth.

about.zh: 推著超音波機走遍全院。最怕病人一躺平就喘。
about.en: Wheels the echo machine all over the hospital. Dreads patients who gasp the moment they lie flat.

about.zh: 把病人帶來的塑膠袋一包一包倒出來看。他說：「藥袋裡沒有，袋子外面才有。」
about.en: Tips every plastic bag of pills out on the desk. "What matters is never in the prescription bag; it's the one beside it."

about.zh: 夜裡會打電話來問「這樣要不要叫你」。答案通常是要。
about.en: Calls at night to ask "should I wake you for this?" The answer is usually yes.

plain.zh: 心臟打不動或放鬆不了，血液與水分積在肺和腳。不是心臟停了，是「泵浦不夠力」。
plain.en: The heart cannot pump or relax well, so blood and water back up into the lungs and legs. Not a stopped heart: a pump that falls short.

plain.zh: 躺平就喘、坐起來才好。積在腳的水躺下時回到胸口，肺就濕了。
plain.en: Breathless lying flat, better sitting up. Lying down returns fluid from the legs to the chest and wets the lungs.

plain.zh: 每次心跳把左心室裡的血打出去的比例。心臟超音波量得到。
plain.en: The share of blood the left ventricle pushes out with each beat, measured on an echocardiogram.

plain.zh: 讓腎臟多排鹽和水的藥，俗稱「排水藥」。種類與劑量依醫囑。
plain.en: A drug that makes the kidneys pass more salt and water, the "water pill". Type and dose per the doctor's orders.

plain.zh: 每天早上同一台秤、同樣衣服、上完廁所後量。短期體重上升多半是水。
plain.en: Same scale, same clothes, every morning after the toilet. A quick gain in weight is mostly water.

plain.zh: 少吃鹽，水就不會被留在身體裡。湯、醬料、醃漬物是大宗。
plain.en: Less salt means less water held in the body. Broth, sauces and pickles carry most of it.

plain.zh: 心肌受傷時跑到血裡的蛋白。高不一定是心肌梗塞，要看趨勢和心電圖。
plain.en: A protein that leaks into blood when heart muscle is injured. High does not always mean a heart attack: look at the trend and the ECG.

plain.zh: 心衰竭時在第二心音後聽到的低沉一聲，像「肯-塔-基」的「基」。
plain.en: A low extra beat after the second heart sound in heart failure, the "-ky" of "Ken-tuc-ky".

plain.zh: 肺底聽到像撕魔鬼氈的細碎聲，代表小氣道裡有水。
plain.en: A fine crackling like velcro peeling at the lung bases: fluid in the small airways.

plain.zh: 水分滲進肺泡，氧氣進不去。胸部 X 光上像蝴蝶翅膀。
plain.en: Fluid seeping into the air sacs so oxygen cannot get through. On a chest X-ray it looks like butterfly wings.

plain.zh: 常見的消炎止痛藥。會讓腎臟留鹽留水，心衰竭病人要避免。
plain.en: Common anti-inflammatory painkillers. They make the kidneys hold salt and water, so heart-failure patients should avoid them.

plain.zh: 衛教後請病人或家屬用自己的話說一遍，確認真的懂了。
plain.en: After teaching, ask the patient or family to explain it in their own words, to check it really landed.

plain.zh: 心臟電流需要的電解質。利尿劑會把它排掉，太低會心律不整。
plain.en: An electrolyte the heart's wiring needs. Diuretics wash it out, and too little causes rhythm problems.

text.zh: 喘到站不穩的病人也能坐著量。每天同一時間、同一台。
text.en: Lets a breathless patient be weighed sitting down. Same time, same chair, every day.

text.zh: 看心臟收縮、瓣膜和心包膜。病人喘的時候，坐著也能做。
text.en: Shows contraction, valves and pericardium. If the patient is breathless, it can be done sitting up.

text.zh: 血氧、心率、呼吸次數。躺平時血氧往下掉，就是答案。
text.en: Saturation, heart rate, breathing rate. A saturation that falls when she lies flat is itself an answer.

text.zh: 一盒非處方的消炎止痛藥，吃掉一半。這次惡化的共犯。
text.en: A box of over-the-counter anti-inflammatories, half gone. An accomplice in this admission.

text.zh: 麵攤的帳本改的。左邊記體重，右邊記「今天試了幾口湯」。
text.en: A converted stall ledger: weight on the left, "spoonfuls of broth tasted today" on the right.

text.zh: 惡化很少是「心臟突然更壞」。先找誘因：停藥（怕跑廁所）、吃太鹹、喝太多水、消炎止痛藥、感染、心房顫動等心律不整、缺血、血壓失控、甲狀腺問題。找到誘因、拿掉它，比加藥更能防下一次住院。
text.en: Decompensation is rarely "the heart suddenly got worse". Look for the trigger: stopped pills (to avoid the toilet), too much salt or fluid, anti-inflammatory painkillers, infection, arrhythmias such as atrial fibrillation, ischaemia, uncontrolled blood pressure, thyroid trouble. Finding and removing the trigger prevents the next admission better than adding a drug.

name.en: The scale is the most honest note

text.zh: 脂肪不會幾天內長出來，短期內上升的體重幾乎都是水。肺積水之前，水先積在腳、在肚子、在體重上。所以出院衛教的核心是：每天量、寫下來、比較昨天、上升就打電話，而不是等到喘才來急診。
text.en: Fat does not appear in a few days; a quick gain is almost all water. Before the lungs flood, water collects in the feet, the belly and on the scale. So the heart of discharge teaching is: weigh daily, write it down, compare with yesterday, phone if it climbs — not wait to be breathless in the ER.

name.zh: 肌鈣蛋白高，不等於心肌梗塞
name.en: High troponin is not always a heart attack

text.zh: 心衰竭、腎功能差、感染、心律不整都會讓肌鈣蛋白輕度上升。心肌梗塞的關鍵是「動態上升或下降」加上缺血證據（症狀、心電圖、影像）。數值平平的輕度升高，多半是心肌受損而不是冠狀動脈塞住，但要在病歷寫清楚你為什麼這樣判斷。
text.en: Heart failure, poor kidneys, infection and arrhythmia all nudge troponin up. A heart attack needs a dynamic rise or fall plus evidence of ischaemia (symptoms, ECG, imaging). A flat, mildly raised value is usually myocardial injury rather than a blocked artery, but write down why you think so.

note.zh: 阿嬌姨三天胖了一圈，都是水
note.en: Three days of weight gain, all of it water

lines.zh: 早。昨晚收的阿嬌姨，心衰竭急性惡化。三個枕頭才睡得著，腳腫到穿不下拖鞋。
lines.en: Morning. Auntie Chiao came in overnight, acute heart failure. Needs three pillows to sleep, ankles too swollen for her slippers.

lines.zh: 體重比上個月門診多很多。今天開始每日體重，同一台椅子量。
lines.en: Much heavier than at last month's clinic. Daily weight starts today, same chair every time.

lines.zh: 體重椅在哪？
lines.en: Where's the weighing chair?

post.zh: 就這台。同一台、同樣衣服、上完廁所。三個「同」。
post.en: This one. Same chair, same clothes, after the toilet. Three "sames".

lines.zh: 早。心衰竭的病人，你第一個看哪個數字？
lines.en: Morning. With a heart-failure patient, which number do you look at first?

lines.zh: 血氧？
lines.en: Saturation?

lines.zh: 體重。脂肪不會三天長出來，三天胖的都是水。
lines.en: Weight. Fat doesn't grow in three days; three days of gain is water.

lines.zh: 第二個問題比較難：她為什麼這週惡化？去問。
lines.en: The second question is harder: why did she tip over this week? Go and ask.

note.zh: 聽到第三心音與肺底囉音，片子是肺水腫
note.en: Third heart sound, basal crackles, oedema on the film

lines.zh: 醫師，我躺下去就像有人坐在我胸口。坐起來就好一點。
lines.en: Doctor, lying down it's like someone sitting on my chest. Sitting up is better.

lines.zh: 這叫端坐呼吸。阿嬌姨，最近排水藥有照吃嗎？
lines.en: That's orthopnoea. Auntie, have you been taking your water pill?

lines.zh: 上禮拜喝喜酒，怕一直跑廁所，停了三天啦。
lines.en: Last week was a wedding banquet. Didn't want to keep running to the loo, so I stopped for three days.

lines.zh: 我來聽一下心臟和肺。
lines.en: Let me listen to your heart and lungs.

post.zh: 第二心音後面多一聲，是第三心音。兩邊肺底都是囉音。
post.en: An extra sound after the second: a third heart sound. Crackles at both lung bases.

post.zh: 頸靜脈呢？坐四十五度看。
post.en: And the neck veins? Look at forty-five degrees.
Distended almost to the earlobe. A lot of water.

guide.zh: 看昨晚的胸部 X 光

lines.zh: 你報。
lines.en: Your read.

question.zh: 心臟大小、肺血管與肋膈角各告訴你什麼？
question.en: What do the heart size, the lung vessels and the costophrenic angles tell you?

answer.zh: 心臟變大；上肺血管比下肺粗（血流重分布）、肺門旁蝴蝶狀陰影與肺底細線（Kerley B 線）是肺水腫；兩側肋膈角變鈍是肋膜積水。整體符合心衰竭急性惡化。
answer.en: Enlarged heart; upper-lobe vessels fuller than lower (redistribution), bat-wing shadowing around the hila and fine basal lines (Kerley B lines) mean pulmonary oedema; blunted angles on both sides are effusions. Together: acute decompensated heart failure.

post.zh: 對。利尿劑依醫囑開始，記錄尿量、腎功能、鉀離子。
post.en: Right. Start the diuretic per protocol; chart urine output, kidney function and potassium.

guide.en: Teach her to record urine output

lines.zh: 阿嬌姨，今天開始尿都尿在這個量杯，我們要知道排了多少水。
lines.en: Auntie, from today everything goes in this measuring jug. We need to know how much water is leaving.

lines.zh: 量杯？我們麵攤也有這個，量湯用的。
lines.en: A measuring jug? We have those at the stall. For the broth.

lines.zh: 那正好。以前量湯，現在量水出去。
lines.en: Perfect. You used to measure broth going in; now we measure water going out.

note.zh: 躺平就掉血氧：坐著做完超音波
note.en: Saturation dropped flat: echo finished sitting up

lines.zh: 阿嬌姨，躺平、往左側一點，我要從心尖照。
lines.en: Auntie, lie flat and roll a little to the left, I need the apical view.
...can't... breathe...

lines.zh: 監視器的血氧數字一格一格往下掉。
lines.en: The saturation on the monitor ticks down, one notch at a time.

options.en: Sit her up, oxygen, call the attending

why.zh: 對。端坐呼吸的人躺平會把水倒回肺裡。超音波可以坐著做，病人先。
why.en: Right. Lying flat pours the water back into her lungs. The echo can be done sitting up; the patient comes first.

options.zh: 再撐一下，照完心尖切面就好
options.en: Hold on, just finish the apical view

why.zh: 影像可以等，缺氧不能等。換姿勢、換切面，不是換病人去配合機器。
why.en: The image can wait; hypoxia cannot. Change the position or the view, not the patient.

options.zh: 給她鎮靜藥讓她躺得住
options.en: Sedate her so she can lie flat

why.zh: 喘是因為肺濕，不是因為緊張。鎮靜會壓抑呼吸，讓情況更糟。
why.en: She is breathless because her lungs are wet, not because she is anxious. Sedation suppresses breathing and makes it worse.

post.zh: 坐起來了，血氧回來了。我從劍突下照也可以。
post.en: She's up and the saturation is back. I can use the subcostal view instead.

post.zh: 早說嘛，我坐著很會配合的。
post.en: Should've said. I'm very cooperative sitting up.

lines.zh: 左心室擴大，收縮很弱，射出分率明顯下降。瓣膜沒有大問題，心包膜沒積水。
lines.en: Left ventricle dilated, contracting weakly, ejection fraction clearly reduced. No major valve problem, no pericardial fluid.

lines.zh: 跟去年比？
lines.en: Compared with last year?

lines.zh: 差不多。心臟沒有突然變壞，是水變多了。
lines.en: About the same. The heart didn't suddenly get worse; there's just more water.

lines.zh: 記住這句。這次是誘因的問題，不是心臟的問題。
lines.en: Remember that. This time it's about the trigger, not the heart.

note.zh: 找到止痛藥；肌鈣蛋白平穩

sub.zh: 阿光：「阿嬌姨的塑膠袋裡多了一盒東西。」
sub.en: Kuang: "There's an extra box in Auntie Chiao's bag."

lines.zh: 處方藥都對，但這盒是鄰居給的消炎止痛藥，吃掉一半了。
lines.en: The prescriptions are fine, but this box is a neighbour's anti-inflammatory. Half gone.

lines.zh: 非類固醇消炎止痛藥。會留鹽留水，還傷腎。
lines.en: An NSAID. Holds salt and water, and hurts the kidneys.

lines.zh: 對。腎功能也比上個月差一點。核對要連腎功能一起看。
lines.en: Exactly. Her kidney function is a bit worse than last month too. Check the kidneys with the drugs.

lines.zh: 急診抽的肌鈣蛋白有一點高。心肌梗塞嗎？
lines.en: The ER troponin is a little high. Heart attack?

lines.zh: 要看趨勢。兩次都差不多，沒有動態上升，她也沒有胸痛。
lines.en: Depends on the trend. Two samples, about the same, no dynamic rise, and she has no chest pain.

lines.zh: 那叫什麼？
lines.en: So what is it?

post.zh: 心衰竭本身就會讓肌鈣蛋白輕度升高。寫清楚你為什麼不是當成心肌梗塞。
post.en: Heart failure alone nudges troponin up. Write down why you are not calling it a heart attack.

lines.zh: 比對入院那張：竇性心律，沒有新的 ST 變化，也沒有心房顫動。
lines.en: Against the admission ECG: sinus rhythm, no new ST changes, no atrial fibrillation.

lines.zh: 好。心律不整也是誘因之一，排掉一個是一個。
lines.en: Good. Arrhythmia is a trigger too; every one you exclude counts.

note.zh: 湯、藥、秤：說給兒子聽，也請他說回來
note.en: Broth, pills, scale: taught and said back

sub.zh: 志明：「我晚上可以帶一碗湯給我媽補一下嗎？」
sub.en: Chih-ming: "Can I bring Mum a bowl of broth tonight?"

lines.zh: 醫師，我媽瘦了，我想帶一碗牛肉湯給她補。她最愛喝自己熬的。
lines.en: Doctor, Mum looks thinner. I want to bring her beef broth to build her up. She loves her own.

lines.zh: 你熬的沒我熬的好啦。
lines.en: Yours isn't as good as mine.

lines.zh: 我先解釋一下為什麼她會喘。
lines.en: Let me explain first why she got breathless.

q.en: How do you talk to Chih-ming about food?

options.zh: 一起講限鹽和水，請他說一遍
options.en: Explain salt and fluid, ask him to say it back

why.zh: 對。回覆示教才知道他真的懂。湯是鹽和水的雙重來源。
why.en: Right. Teach-back is how you know it landed. Broth is salt and water in one bowl.

why.zh: 衛教單不會自己被讀。沒有對話，就沒有理解。
why.en: Leaflets do not read themselves. Without a conversation there is no understanding.

options.zh: 住院中，想吃什麼都可以
options.en: She's in hospital; she can eat what she likes

why.zh: 住院中更要開始練習。一碗湯可以把今天排掉的水全部喝回來。
why.en: Hospital is where the practice starts. One bowl can drink back everything the diuretic took out today.

post.zh: 所以媽媽的湯，是她的病的一半？
post.en: So Mum's broth is half her illness?

post.zh: 湯沒有錯，是份量。限鹽不是不能喝，我們一起想辦法。
post.en: The broth isn't wrong; it's the amount. Salt restriction doesn't mean none. We'll work it out together.

lines.zh: 阿嬌姨，回家以後每天早上照這個順序。
lines.en: Auntie, at home every morning, in this order.

lines.zh: 比熬湯簡單嗎？
lines.en: Easier than making broth?

lines.zh: 簡單很多，但每天都要做。
lines.en: Much easier, but every single day.

q.zh: 心衰竭病人每天早上的自我照顧順序
q.en: A heart-failure patient's morning routine, in order

steps.en: Get up and use the toilet

steps.zh: 明顯上升或腳腫就打電話
steps.en: Phone if it clearly rises or the ankles swell

steps.zh: 照時間吃藥，包括利尿劑
steps.en: Take the pills on time, water pill included

post.zh: 佳蓉從口袋拿出一支醬油小湯匙：「這一匙，就是妳一天的鹽。」
post.en: Chia-jung takes out her soy-sauce teaspoon: "This spoon is your whole day of salt."

post.zh: 一匙？我試湯一次就不只了。
post.en: One spoon? I taste more than that in one go.

lines.zh: 出院計畫寫三件事：誘因怎麼拿掉、藥怎麼調、誰在什麼時候打電話給她。
lines.en: Three things in the plan: how the trigger is removed, how the drugs change, who calls her and when.

lines.zh: 停止消炎止痛藥，膝蓋痛轉骨科。心衰竭藥物依指引逐步調整。佳蓉出院後一週追蹤。
lines.en: Stop the NSAID and refer the knee to orthopaedics. Titrate heart-failure drugs per guideline. Chia-jung phones a week after discharge.

lines.zh: 膝蓋痛也是病。不給她別的辦法，她會再去跟鄰居拿。
lines.en: The knee pain is real. Give her nothing else and she'll go back to the neighbour.

note.zh: 尿量足夠，體重開始往下
note.en: Good urine output; the weight starts falling

lines.zh: 醫師，我今天尿了好多，兩個枕頭就躺得住了。
lines.en: Doctor, I've peed so much today. Two pillows and I can lie back.

lines.zh: 腳踝也鬆了。明天早上量體重，我們一起看。
lines.en: Your ankles are looser too. We'll look at the scale together tomorrow morning.

lines.zh: 我把麵攤的帳本拿來當體重本。左邊寫體重，右邊寫試了幾口湯。
lines.en: I'm using my stall ledger as a weight diary. Weight on the left, spoonfuls of broth on the right.

lines.zh: 今天的心衰竭，心臟其實沒變。變的是什麼？
lines.en: Today's heart failure: the heart didn't change. What did?

lines.zh: 停了三天利尿劑、鄰居的止痛藥、一天幾十口湯。
lines.en: Three days without the water pill, the neighbour's painkiller, dozens of spoonfuls of broth.

lines.zh: 對。我們開的藥只佔一半，另一半在她家廚房。
lines.en: Right. Our drugs are only half the treatment. The other half is in her kitchen.

sub.zh: 小真：「阿嬌姨的鉀離子報告出來了，還有……湯。」
sub.en: Chen: "Auntie Chiao's potassium is back. And... the broth."

lines.zh: 醫師，阿嬌姨晚上的鉀離子偏低，她說有一點心悸。
lines.en: Doctor, Auntie Chiao's evening potassium is low and she says her heart is fluttering a bit.

lines.zh: 監視器上是什麼節律？
lines.en: What rhythm is on the monitor?

lines.zh: 竇性心律，偶爾早期收縮。血壓、血氧都穩。
lines.en: Sinus, the odd ectopic beat. Pressure and saturation steady.

lines.zh: 補鉀依醫囑，加一張心電圖，明早再抽。利尿劑排水，也排鉀。
lines.en: Replace potassium per protocol, add an ECG, recheck in the morning. The diuretic washes out potassium with the water.

lines.zh: 還有，志明帶了一大碗牛肉湯來，阿嬌姨喝完了。衛教單在他包包裡，沒拆。
lines.en: Also, Chih-ming brought a big bowl of beef broth and she finished it. The leaflet is in his bag, unopened.

lines.zh: ……明天早上的體重會告訴我們。我會再跟志明好好談一次。
lines.en: ...tomorrow's weight will tell us. I'll sit down with Chih-ming properly again.

lines.zh: 還有，志明帶了一大碗牛肉湯，說醫師講想吃什麼都可以。她喝完了，現在要三個枕頭。
lines.en: Also, Chih-ming brought a big bowl of broth, said the doctor allowed anything. She finished it and needs three pillows again.

lines.zh: 是我講錯了。先讓她坐起來、監測血氧，我過去。明天重新衛教。
lines.en: That was my mistake. Sit her up, watch the saturation, I'm coming. We'll redo the teaching tomorrow.

lines.zh: 還有，志明帶了湯，但只倒了一小杯，說「醫師說的，一天一匙鹽」。
lines.en: Also, Chih-ming brought broth but only poured a little cup. "The doctor said: one spoon of salt a day."

lines.zh: 他記住了。那一小杯，可以。
lines.en: He remembered. That little cup is fine.

lines.zh: 值班結束。阿嬌姨的帳本上，左邊第一行寫著今天的體重，右邊寫著：兩口。
lines.en: End of shift. In Auntie Chiao's ledger, the first line on the left is today's weight. On the right: two spoonfuls.

sub.zh: 體重往下，枕頭變少，湯只喝兩口
sub.en: Weight down, fewer pillows, two spoonfuls of broth
